posts.zh:
DSH-taskboard 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a5f2c4c64bea381d9c01.html
posts.en:
DSH-taskboard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local SQLite taskboard as a native overlay page: projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments and workflow automation, with backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done statuses, `taskboard_*` Agent tools that can only submit work to in_review, a headless JSON CLI and a packaged skill.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a5f2c4c64bea381d9c01.html
